radios.label: MIDS: voice net A is the flight channel, voice net B the squadron net

rules.text: The STN is the four-digit flight block followed by the member digit.
The laser code is 1, the two-digit flight block and the member digit.
Mode 3 is the STN without its leading 0.
Mode 1 is the two-digit squadron code of the squadron record: squadron digit 1-4 then 0, support 70 (second digit 0-3 in DCS).
The wing air-to-air TACAN channel is the lead channel plus 63, in the same band.
